visualCharacteristics.purpose: Solution entry points: image cards with a two-line heading, description and a link to the solution page
visualCharacteristics.layout: Three equal columns on desktop, two on tablet, one on mobile; image on top, text below, set on a dark textured section

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: card image; cell 2: heading (two lines, e.g. 'Solutions by' / 'Market'), description paragraph, CTA link ('Go Now')

usage.description: Navigational cards splitting solutions by market, role or requirement.

reuseGuidance: Use for image-top cards linking to category pages. For icon + label quick links use cards-icon-links.
